results.title: How to Cross-Compile Go Programs (GOOS and GOARCH) — Go FAQ
results.snippet: To cross-compile a Go program, simply set the `GOOS` and `GOARCH` environment variables before running `go build`, which tells the compiler to generate binaries for a different operating system and CPU architecture than your host machine.

results.title: Effortless Cross Compilation In Go With GOOS And GOARCH
results.snippet: Before using the go build command, you must set the GOOS and GOARCH environment variables to the target you want to use in order to cross-compile a Go application.
